card.name: Web page footer and citation wording
card.fires_on: Words in copyright, trademark and citation lines, such as 'trademarks of', 'Book title', and 'Contributors', where a name or title comes next. Also 'strains of' before an organism name.

modes.label: Copyright and trademark lines
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'trademarks' or 'strains', just before a proper name.
modes.example: Healthwise, Healthwise for every health decision, and the Healthwise logo are trademarks<< of>> Healthwise, Incorporated.

modes.label: Citation field labels
modes.description: Field labels in a book citation, such as Contributors or title, just before a colon or name.

modes.label: Other mid-phrase words
modes.description: A scattered word inside plant descriptions or religious text, before a continuing phrase.

card.writes: Weakly pushes toward Chinese-character and odd word-start tokens, with no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on small words in website footers and citations that come right before a name or title.
